title: hesperis matronalis subsp. nivea
intro: Hesperis matronalis subsp. nivea, commonly known as White Sweet Rocket or White Dame's Rocket, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a perennial herb with white flowers that have a sweet fragrance and are often used as an ornamental plant. The health benefits of Hesperis matronalis subsp. nivea include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic effects.
